Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: it was difficult to understand the rules of housing registration in regards to the enrollment. I was not sure if I was even allowed to take my exams if I was not oficially registered for a place to live.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We were informed at the university that we didn't need to register for housing. This would have been much easier to find a place to live if I had known this before arrival.

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: it was very very difficult.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: if you are a erasmus student and you're staying for one semester that you don't need housing in the netherlands with registration.

How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: very easy

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: it was done online. I had to choose from the course catalogue.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: they were very good at asnwering question via email.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I couldn't apply for many courses in my own field. So my advice is to not be afraid of applying for something that is outside of your field.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: both the lecturers and the students were working on a very high level. Everyone were very active in the class discussions and very well prepared.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The class discussions and the way the teachers really engaged with the students and the students engaged with each other was just great. at UCPH it feels more like a seminar at times than an actual class.

questions.answer: start searching for housing ASAP. You don't need to register. Be careful of scammers.
